name: rediarize-fewer-speakers
why: The re-run finds two speakers where the last found three — a quieter participant clustered away. The third prior speaker keeps its row and its name, unmatched, rather than being deleted. Unmatched prior speakers are never removed: the name is a fact about the recording, and a diarizer having a worse day is not evidence that the person was not there.

expect.note: SPEAKER_01 overlaps spk-u-maung by 30000 ms and spk-quiet by 4000 ms; the assignment must not hand it to spk-quiet, and spk-quiet's row survives regardless.
